about: [C11 critic] VI on foot at the wreck: round to his back and up to his tail lamp (3 m, 1 m, at the bumper): does the red glow stay near its housing's size?

steps.eval: (window.__tailFails = [], window.__c3tries = 0, window.__b0 = N.time, window.__ph = {}, setInterval(() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx && G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; if (C && !window.__ph[C.phase]) window.__ph[C.phase] = +(N.time - window.__b0).toFixed(1); if (C && C.crashLog) { window.__crashLog = C.crashLog; window.__knocks = C.knocks; window.__lastRam = C.lastRam; } }, 100), 1)

steps.walk: (() => { const C=G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; const g=C.his.tail.userData.glows[0]; const p=g.getWorldPosition(new (G.camera.position.constructor)()); const dx=p.x-C.his.pos.x, dz=p.z-C.his.pos.z, d=Math.hypot(dx,dz), ux=dx/d, uz=dz/d; return [[C.his.pos.x+ux*(d+4.0)-uz*3.5, C.his.pos.z+uz*(d+4.0)+ux*3.5]]; })()

(() => { const C=G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; const g=C.his.tail.userData.glows[0]; const p=g.getWorldPosition(new (G.camera.position.constructor)()); const dx=p.x-C.his.pos.x, dz=p.z-C.his.pos.z, d=Math.hypot(dx,dz), ux=dx/d, uz=dz/d; return [[C.his.pos.x+ux*(d+3.0)-uz*0, C.his.pos.z+uz*(d+3.0)+ux*0]]; })()

steps.look: (() => { const C=G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; const g=C.his.tail.userData.glows[0]; const p=g.getWorldPosition(new (G.camera.position.constructor)()); const e=G.camera.getWorldPosition(new (G.camera.position.constructor)()); const want=Math.atan2(-(p.x-e.x), -(p.z-e.z)); const pw=Math.atan2(p.y-e.y, Math.hypot(p.x-e.x,p.z-e.z)); const dy=Math.atan2(Math.sin(want-N.controller.yaw),Math.cos(want-N.controller.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy/N.controller.sensitivity), Math.round((N.controller.pitch-pw)/N.controller.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const C=G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; const gs=C.his.tail.userData.glows; const e=G.camera.getWorldPosition(new (G.camera.position.constructor)()); return JSON.stringify(gs.map(g=>{const p=g.getWorldPosition(new (G.camera.position.constructor)()); return {d:+p.distanceTo(e).toFixed(2), scale:+g.scale.x.toFixed(3), wish:g.userData.wish};})); })()
